summary.en: Chinese coast guard and navy vessels are conducting combat-readiness patrols and water-cannon drills around Scarborough Shoal and Panatag Shoal, while a carrier group that includes Liaoning has entered the western Pacific, prompting alarms from the Philippines, Taiwan and Japan. The Philippine Coast Guard is delivering fuel to Filipino fishermen at Scarborough Shoal and jointly conducting a search-and-rescue exercise with the US Coast Guard in the West Philippine Sea. A ferry listing off Quezon Province was rescued, saving 58 passengers. The conflict recorded 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
